mechanism: Both agents have vasoconstrictive properties; brimonidine is an alpha-2 agonist that can cause systemic absorption with potential additive cardiovascular effects when combined with sumatriptan's 5-HT1B/1D receptor agonism.
action: Monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular symptoms; use brimonidine ophthalmic cautiously in patients requiring sumatriptan, ensuring proper instillation technique to minimize systemic absorption.
